verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists forecasting as its own capability ('Sales Quoting and Forecasting', 'Predictive Forecasting', 'Advanced Forecast & Pipeline Management'), and the product page claims pipeline visibility and opportunity management. These are only feature-list mentions, with no detail on how forecasts are built from pipeline value, stage probabilities and close dates. Missing for 10: documentation of weighted pipeline forecasting by stage probability, use of close dates and forecast periods, founder-level rollup views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
